faq.question: What does Bilkisu mean?

faq.question: What is the origin of Bilkisu?
faq.answer: Bilkisu is associated with Arabic. Bilkisu is the Hausa form of Arabic بَلْقِيس (Balqīs), the name traditionally given to the Queen of Sheba.

faq.question: Is Bilkisu an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form بَلْقِيس is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Bilkisu an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Bilkisu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Bilkisu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Balqīs is not a Quranic personal name, though the Queen of Sheba is alluded to in the Quran.
